question: Does the existing synthetic training path expose a signed, first-action-specific causal credit signal at the selected plastic synapses without adding an information channel?
evidence: exact current source for exploration, readout, game-action handling, reward delivery and eligibility
primary_endpoint: Presence or absence of both an action-boundary feedback event for null first DOWN and a signed synapse-specific or motor-specific perturbation/eligibility term in the current learning path.
secondary_endpoints: fraction of original frozen GOOD+ preceded by a null DOWN
whether the orchestration has access to game disposition before the final judgement

interpretation_locked_before_audit.pass: Both action-boundary feedback and signed causal perturbation/eligibility are already present and enough to specify a deterministic candidate without another interface.
interpretation_locked_before_audit.fail: Either ingredient is absent. Identify its minimal insertion point, but do not invent a behavioral result or call a candidate validated.
interpretation_locked_before_audit.inconclusive: Source or historical audit cannot establish the relevant path unambiguously.

prohibitions: no new training or frozen probe
no learning-rate, threshold, edge-mask or reward-strength search
no claim that interface absence alone proves a particular replacement rule will pass M2
stop: Save a source-backed design-readiness report and propose one next discriminating stage; do not run it in A8.
